decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's core organic dairy and cheese knowledge, so management can interpret results and refine it, and it was still featured on its own page in 2019.

The spicy cheese builds on the established cheese expertise and still had its own page in 2019, but flavoured variants like the dropped onion-and-pepper cheese show such line extensions are more prone to pruning in a narrow portfolio.

The mild creamy soft cheese draws on existing dairy knowledge and was actively promoted, though the early removal of the washed-rind soft cheese suggests soft cheeses carry some risk for a firm without strong research links.
